    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_invst_pln.InvestmentFundingPMOActualsHelperBase</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>InvestmentFundingPMOActualsHelperBase</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var InvestmentFundingPMOActualsHelperBase = Class.create();
InvestmentFundingPMOActualsHelperBase.prototype = {

    initialize: function() {
        this.CONSTANTS = InvstPlanningConstants;
    },

    fetchActualsAggregateForFiscalPeriods: function(fiscalPeriods, fundingEntityId) {
        var _self = this;
        var fiscalPeriodsWithActuals = [];
        fiscalPeriods.forEach(function(fiscalPeriod) {
            var actuals = _self.getActualsAggregateforFiscalPeriod(fundingEntityId, fiscalPeriod.sys_id);
            Object.extend(fiscalPeriod, actuals);
			fiscalPeriodsWithActuals.push(fiscalPeriod);
        });

        return fiscalPeriodsWithActuals;
    },

    getActualsAggregateforFiscalPeriod: function(fundingEntityId, fiscalPeriodId) {
        var referenceCurrencySymbol = new InvestmentFundingUtil().getCurrency2ReferenceCurrencySymbol(this.CONSTANTS.FUNDING_BASE_FUND_TBL,
            this.CONSTANTS.FUNDED_AMT_REFERENCE_AMOUNT_FLD);

        var invstCurrencyFormatter = new InvstCurrencyFormatter(referenceCurrencySymbol);

        var result = {
            total_actual: invstCurrencyFormatter.getFormattedAmount(0),
            capex_actual: invstCurrencyFormatter.getFormattedAmount(0),
            opex_actual: invstCurrencyFormatter.getFormattedAmount(0)
        };
        var total = 0;
        var fp = new GlideRecord(this.CONSTANTS.FISCAL_PERIOD);
        if (fp.get(fiscalPeriodId)) {

            var startDate = new GlideScheduleDateTime(fp.start_date_time.getDisplayValue()).getGlideDateTime().getDate();
			var endDate =  new GlideScheduleDateTime(fp.end_date_time.getDisplayValue()).getGlideDateTime().getDate();
			
            var actualsAmount = this.getActualsInDateRange(startDate, endDate, fundingEntityId);

            result.fiscal_period_name = fp.getDisplayValue('name');
            result.opex_actual = invstCurrencyFormatter.getFormattedAmount(actualsAmount.actual_amount_opex);
            result.capex_actual = invstCurrencyFormatter.getFormattedAmount(actualsAmount.actual_amount_capex);
            total = actualsAmount.actual_amount_opex + actualsAmount.actual_amount_capex;
            result.total_actual = invstCurrencyFormatter.getFormattedAmount(total);
        }

        return result;

    },

    getActualsInDateRange: function(startDate, endDate, fundingEntityId) {
        var res = {
			actual_amount_capex: 0,
			actual_amount_opex: 0
		};
        var costRollUpEnabled = new InvestmentFundingUtil().isCostRollUpEnabled();
        var sourceIds = [fundingEntityId];
        var gr = new GlideAggregate('fm_expense_line');
        if (costRollUpEnabled) {
            var subChildIds = this.getFundingEntitySubChildIds(fundingEntityId);
            sourceIds = sourceIds.concat(subChildIds);
        }
        gr.addQuery('source_id', 'IN', sourceIds);
        gr.addQuery('date', '>=', startDate);
        gr.addQuery('date', '<=', endDate);
        gr.addQuery('state', 'processed');
        gr.addAggregate('SUM', 'amount');
        gr.groupBy('expense_type');
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next())
            res['actual_amount_' + gr.getValue('expense_type')] = isNaN(parseFloat(gr.getAggregate('SUM', 'amount'))) ? 0 : parseFloat(gr.getAggregate('SUM', 'amount'));
        return res;
    },
	
	getFundingEntitySubChildIds: function(entityId) {	
		var gr = new GlideRecord(this.CONSTANTS.PLANNED_TASK_TBL);	
		gr.addQuery('top_task', entityId);	
		gr.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', entityId);	
		gr.addQuery('work_cost', '>', 0);	
		gr.addNotNullQuery('parent');	
		gr.query();	
		var subChildIds = [];	
		while(gr.next()){	
			subChildIds.push(gr.getUniqueValue());	
		}	
		return subChildIds;	
	},

    type: 'InvestmentFundingPMOActualsHelperBase'
};]]></script>
